assets.title: Season key visual
observations: Landscape and portrait sources and exports preserve the exact series identity “The Climb”, “by AI Ascension”, and the season title “Road to the First Verified Win”; the landscape hierarchy is readable in two title lines and the portrait hierarchy in three.

The branching-A mark remains modest, and the dark/amber paths lead toward an open unfinished horizon. No trophy, celebration, victory badge, game screenshot, character, actual map, score, date, schedule, or live claim is present.
Both outputs are clean full-frame RGB exports at the required 1920x1080 and 1080x1920 sizes with no visible crop loss or extra wording.
